decision_reason: The first material obstruction is a missing certified state-domain/branch tube, not compute capacity. GitHub Actions cannot resolve that prerequisite and would add integration overhead to a sub-second preflight.

github_actions_estimate.current_terminal_preflight: same tiny sequential checks plus workflow/checkout/artifact overhead; no scientific benefit

local_estimate.current_terminal_preflight: well below 1 s measured for result+validator kernel, plus file packaging/hashing; comfortably local
local_estimate.future_full_campaign: not responsibly estimable until full post-event/frec/reio state-tube/domain/branch certificate exists and one representative paired cell can be benchmarked

reassess_if: A complete all-four post-event/frec/reio state-tube/domain/branch certificate covering through a=1 is available; benchmark one paired continuation cell before choosing the full-history backend.
